about: How tools/pack.py builds Blackrock Mountain 2015 (docs/packs/format.md, 'Build recipes'): on Goblins vs Gnomes (base), so on Naxxramas and Classic: their cards, patches, scripts, fonts, texts and pictures by reference, without Classic's hand-tuned text layout (skip); then the Blackrock Mountain cards and their tokens (data/brm_cards.json, tools/extract_cards.py --set brm) with the names and texts of build 8311 (patch 2.4.0.8311, 2015-03-31, two days before the first wing) for every card of the chain (cards.texts.json, written by the same tool), and this pack's own patch (cards.patch.json: the release stats, the scripts of scripts/brm.lua, the older cards that patch fixed).
